data_contract.control_input: pump voltage; zero-order hold between samples
data_contract.measured_output: lower-tank water level, with capacitive sensor noise
data_contract.input_design: multisine; paper reports excitation from 0 to 0.0144 Hz
data_contract.official_split: uEst/yEst are estimation data; uVal/yVal are test data; benchmark specification says the test record must not be used for model estimation
data_contract.initial_state: unknown at record start; the benchmark document says estimation and test records share the same unknown initial state
data_contract.noise_and_nonlinearity: benchmark document reports about 40 dB output SNR and overflow-related hard saturation plus input-dependent process noise
data_contract.physical_boundaries: overflow is documented, but an engineering water-level limit, units for the CSV y values, and safety envelope were not independently established

benchmark_status: source admitted and hashed; no models trained or benchmark scores generated in this audit
